description: This file contains implementation of the inet_pton function for IPv4 and IPv6 address conversion, including internal static functions inet_pton4 and inet_pton6, with support for different address families and compatibility considerations.

methods.name: inet_pton4
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from presentation to network format, parsing dotted decimal notation.

methods.name: inet_pton6
methods.description: Converts IPv6 address from presentation to network format, handling IPv6 notation including shorthand and embedded IPv4 addresses.
